messages:
Sofia (Marketing): Quick thread to lock the webinar plan — topic: "Practical LLM Serving: cost, latency, and rollout patterns". Need final speaker list, one-line abstracts, rehearsal time, and inbound lead routing. Suggestions?

Ravi (Product): love it. can we frame one segment as a mini-benchmark narrative: latency vs cost tradeoffs with real numbers from Redwood Dedicated? 3 slides max.

Eva (Growth): Agree. Also: CTA segmentation — track enterprise leads vs self-serve. We should have distinct registrant flows.

Jon (Eng): I can pull a short perf table (p95 latency, tokens/sec, cost per 1k tokens) — will need model, seq len, and batch config. ETA end of day.

Marta (Speaker Ops): Speakers: Priya (SR Eng), Omar (Solutions), Lina (Customer success). Priya can do the benchmark bit, Omar handles architecture / routing, Lina covers customer use-cases. Need bio blurbs from each.

Sofia (Marketing): Nice lineup. Draft abstracts (first pass):
- Priya: "Benchmarking inference: how batching, KV caching, and quantization changed our unit economics" (5 min).
- Omar: "Smart routing and graceful degradation: design patterns for reliable production serving" (10 min).
- Lina: "Customer case: migrating from single-host endpoints to Redwood Dedicated — outcomes and pitfalls" (8 min).

Ravi (Product): Minor edit: make Priya's title emphasize actionable configs (e.g., include the exact batch sizes and quant gains to expect). Buyers want numbers.

Eva (Growth): For registration flows: enterprise = ask for company + job title and route to SFDC queue MKT-LLM-WEBINAR-enterprise. Self-serve = minimal info, opt-in for product updates. We should add a GTM field (interest: dedicated/private/hosted).

Kai (Mktg Ops): Routing note: webhook -> /webhooks/marketing/llm-webinar will tag leads with source=webinar-031. I can update HubSpot/Marketo mapping. Also recommend TTL for the contact owner assignment = 24h.

Jon (Eng): Quick addition to the run-of-show stub. Code block: \n```\n00:00 - Host intro (Sofia)\n02:00 - Priya: benchmarks (slides + live demo)\n12:00 - Omar: routing + failover patterns\n22:00 - Lina: customer story + Q&A segue\n28:00 - Panel Q&A (all)\n40:00 - CTAs + next steps\n```\n
Sofia (Marketing): Rehearsal windows: Tue 10:00 PT (tech check), Thu 09:00 PT (run-through). Which works for speakers?

Marta (Speaker Ops): Tue 10:00 PT is okay for Priya & Lina. Omar is out Tue morning, can do Thu. Propose full run-through Thu 09:00 PT.

Eva (Growth): I'll prep email invite copy + landing variants A/B. Suggest variant A lead with benchmarks headline, variant B lead with customer ROI.

Sofia (Marketing): Copy drafts please by EOD Wednesday. Also need one 2-sentence social blurb and one LinkedIn carousel idea.

Kai (Mktg Ops): Analytics plan: UTM params: utm_source=webinar, utm_campaign=llm_serving_031, utm_medium=email. Funnel events: register, attended_10m, attended_30m, requested_demo. I'll hook into Amplitude.

Ravi (Product): For benchmark narrative — include fallback story: what happens when Dedicated capacity is exhausted and we route to hosted variant (latency/cost delta). Helps enterprise customers understand SLA failover.

Jon (Eng): I'll attach the perf table in the rehearsal Slack thread (short screenshot). For the live demo: recommend a pre-recorded clip for the heavy perf test to avoid infra flakiness.

Sofia (Marketing): Good call — pre-record demo snippet + live Q&A for trust. Lina, can you provide a customer quote we can use on the slide?

Lina (Customer Success): Yep — will get a one-liner from Acme Corp: "Switched to Redwood Dedicated and halved inference costs while keeping 99th percentile latency below 200ms." Sending to you by EOD.

Marta (Speaker Ops): Logistics checklist for Thu run-through: mic checks, screenshare permissions, presenters added to webinar host list, slide deck in shared drive. I'll send calendar invites for Tue/Thu.

Sofia (Marketing): Final ask: recording release policy and lead follow-up cadence. Recommend: recording available to registrants immediately after, 2-touch follow-up (1 day and 7 days) + outreach to enterprise leads within 24h.

Eva (Growth): +1. Also recommend a short nurture track for attendees who didn't convert — 3 emails over 3 weeks with benchmark highlights and demo CTA.

Kai (Mktg Ops): ops-bot: create task MKT-LLM-WEB-031 in project board and assign to Sofia, Kai, Marta.

ops-bot: Task created: MKT-LLM-WEB-031 assigned to Sofia (Marketing), Kai (Mktg Ops), Marta (Speaker Ops). Due 2026-04-05.

Sofia (Marketing): Great. I'll compile abstracts + speaker bios + run-of-show into the shared doc and ping again when done. Thanks all :rocket:
